item.name: Performance Optimizer
item.summary: Performance analysis and optimization specialist. Use PROACTIVELY for identifying bottlenecks, optimizing slow code, reducing bundle sizes, and improving runtime performance. Profiling, memory leaks, render optimization, and algorithmic improvements.
